Sandbox_OMHTurretsTraps_Enabled_tooltip: Enables implemented defenses. Turning this off prevents construction and operation while preserving placed objects, collision and condition. This development build supports gameplay construction in single-player only.
Sandbox_OMHTurretsTraps_SpikeBarrier_too: Enables native Spike Barrier construction and front/side thump damage. Disabling preserves existing barriers and their collision and condition. Single-player construction and damage in this development build.
Sandbox_OMHTurretsTraps_DiagnosticLoggin: Records construction parts, coordinates, shared identity, build-cheat state, native object/sprite state, combat decisions and periodic summaries in console.txt. Active with the mod or Foundation Test Controls enabled. Rate limited. Enabled by default for this development test.
Sandbox_OMHTurretsTraps_FoundationTestCo: Development test only. Enables test cube placement, inspection, condition changes and removal. Multiplayer requires the debug context menu permission. Maximum 64 distinct test tiles per world, including removed devices. Use a disposable test world. Disabling controls preserves existing devices.
Sandbox_OMHTurretsTraps_SpikeBarrierDama: Damage per thump from the front or side ends. Default 10. Set 0 to disable retaliation. Uses the same readable damage units as the barrier statistics.
Sandbox_OMHTurretsTraps_SpikeBarrierHeal: Shared maximum HP for the complete 1x2 barrier. Default 100. Existing barriers retain their remaining durability percentage when this changes. Free Repair restores this maximum.
